text: Three projects into this capstone chapter, the pattern is obvious: every project is a composition exercise. Project 3 alone reached across all four courses in the track in just three lessons.

Kickoff fixed the scenario and latency budget before any tool was chosen. Ingestion computed rolling features on a sliding window. Scoring and alerting closed the loop, made idempotent with a keyed merge.

Same three retrospective questions as Project 2, applied to a very different system. Writing it down matters more here, not less: real-time systems fail in ways that are harder to notice after the fact.
All three capstone projects are complete. What's left is a genuine turn — turning these projects into a portfolio and an interview story that gets attention. Next up: building that portfolio.
